title: Geometric Frobenius coefficient comparison data
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a simultaneous coefficient/pullback comparison system $S$ [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum], and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. A geometric-Frobenius coefficient comparison means the structure consisting of the Noetherian, finite-dimensional and $\ell$-invertibility facts for $X$, an equivalence from its framework common-stage Weil-pair category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] to the fixed pairs for the actual PBC completed common-stage Frobenius pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and, for every finite coefficient field $E\subset\Omega$, an equivalence from the framework $E$-Weil pairs to fixed pairs for the $E$-component of that PBC pullback family. The common-stage functor is exactly the fixed-pair transport induced by $S$'s prescribed Frobenius pullback comparison; each finite-stage functor is exactly the fixed-pair transport induced by its prescribed rational comparison. Both equalities retain the actual underlying functors and intertwining arrows. This is data with its normalization, not an existence assertion.
